description: Use this when you need clean Markdown or plain text from a PDF. Self-hosted on BitTuitive hardware (no upstream). Pass url (a public http(s) PDF) or file_base64, optional pages (for example "1-3" or "1,3,5"). Max 20 MB and 100 pages. Priced per page at $0.0005 with a $0.002 USDC minimum, plus the BitTuitive fee max(20%, 3 sats). Unpaid calls return an L402 invoice and an x402 quote. A scanned PDF with no text layer is not converted; if you already paid you get a 24h credit. Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Example: convert_pdf(url="https://api.bittuitive.ai/static/sample.pdf", pages="1-2") Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit.description: 24h credit token from an earlier failed convert_pdf call.

credit_token.description: Prepaid btf_ token (or pass Authorization elsewhere).

file_base64.description: Raw PDF bytes, base64-encoded (alternative to url).

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

pages.description: Optional page range, e.g. "1-3", "1,3,5", or {start, end}.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of a PDF (max 20 MB).

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
